title: Board recorder to JSONL with digest
spec: Add src/recorder/record.ts: recordRoom({ client, room, since, sink, maxPages }) walks forward with readForward, writes one JSON line per message (seq, ts, from, text, sig, nonce — exactly the venue fields, nothing added) and returns { cursor, count, sha256 } where the digest is over the emitted bytes. A second run from the returned cursor appends only new messages.
done: Recording the paging fixture reproduces the pinned digest and a resumed run appends nothing.
